usageNotes: Use this to update the comment or nomatch flag on an existing IP/CIDR entry within a cluster-level firewall IPset. The caller must hold the Sys.Modify privilege at the root path (/). Pass the current config digest to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other.

examples.summary: Set the nomatch flag on a CIDR entry to exclude it from the IPset match

params.comment: Exclude branch office subnet from trusted-offices set

tips: The nomatch flag inverts the entry's match within the IPset — useful for punching exceptions into a broad CIDR without removing the surrounding range.
Fetch the current digest via get_cluster_firewall_ipset_name before calling this endpoint to avoid overwriting concurrent changes.
The cidr path param accepts plain IPs, CIDR notation, or IPset aliases — match exactly how the entry was originally created.
Returns null on success; any error is signalled via HTTP status code, not a response body.
